name: Bridge over a river
desc: A crossing with nowhere to hide - for goodbyes, standoffs and stopping halfway.
tags: bridge over a river, iron railings, lamp posts along the parapet, wide river below, city bank in the distance, lights reflected on water, wet flagstones, stone arches under the span
prose: a broad bridge crossing a river, lamp posts and iron railings running the length of the parapet, water moving below and the far bank of the city standing beyond it
note: Bridge type is a coin flip unless stated - stone arch, steel truss and modern suspension all answer to the same word and each gives a completely different silhouette. The railing and lamp posts are what let a figure stand at something; without them the deck is a blank road with no edge. Name the water surface too, or the river renders as flat grey nothing.
